title: Sigh is hyperimmunogenic and upregulates genes associated with anti-TB immunity in human macrophages
description: CD14+ bead purified human macrophages were pooled and infected with sigH and CDC1551. Mtb (MOI=1) for 4 hours. Two pools (n=2 M and n=2 F each) of donor derived human macrophages were infected as above and subjected to RNAseq at 18 hours. post infection (Novogene USA).
